query: The Right Page Every book you touch falls open at the page you need, now. The trouble is the library knows it, and books are leaving their shelves to come and find you. Footnote is sitting on the biggest. Read every page they offer You read every page that offers itself until the lamps go out. You learn a great deal, most of it useful, and none of it what you came in for. Find one thing for your exams You ask for one thing, firmly. Twelve books bring it. You take your page and leave the others, who sulk on the table until a clerk shelves them.

Footnote's Drawer
Footnote has sat on one catalogue drawer for a week and hisses at anyone who comes near it. The label underneath him says OVERDUE, ELEVEN YEARS. The head librarian says whoever finds that book is welcome to the trick of finding books.
